.pixel-details-gallery { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--pixel-lemon); grid-template-columns: 0.72fr 1.28fr; gap: 42px; padding: 20px 0px 29px; display: grid; }
.pixel-spec-list { border-top: 1px solid rgb(53, 53, 53); margin-top: 14px; }
.pixel-spec-row { border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(53, 53, 53); grid-template-columns: 0.86fr 1.14fr; align-items: center; gap: 16px; min-height: 32px; display: grid; }
.pixel-spec-row span { color: var(--pixel-white); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; }
.pixel-spec-row strong { color: var(--pixel-white); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; }
.pixel-gallery-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0px, 1fr)); gap: 9px; margin-top: 14px; display: grid; }
.pixel-gallery-item { aspect-ratio: 1 / 0.96; background: rgb(17, 17, 17); border: 1px solid rgb(53, 53, 53); width: 100%; padding: 0px; overflow: hidden; }
.pixel-gallery-item img { object-fit: cover; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.pixel-gallery-item:hover { border-color: var(--pixel-lemon); }
.pixel-bottom-strip { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--pixel-lemon); grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 70px; padding: 24px 0px 28px; display: grid; }
.pixel-bottom-item { grid-template-columns: 43px minmax(0px, 1fr); align-items: start; gap: 13px; display: grid; }
.pixel-bottom-icon { width: 35px; height: 35px; color: var(--pixel-lemon); }
.pixel-bottom-icon svg { fill: none; stroke: currentcolor; stroke-width: 1.25px; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.pixel-bottom-label { margin-bottom: 13px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.15; }
.pixel-bottom-item p { color: var(--pixel-white); margin: 0px 0px 5px; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.3; }
.pixel-box-list { margin: 0px 0px 12px; padding: 0px; list-style: none; }
.pixel-box-list li { color: var(--pixel-white); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.6; }
.pixel-box-image { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; object-fit: cover; border: 1px solid var(--pixel-line); width: 100%; max-width: 320px; height: auto; display: block; }

.pixel-image-unavailable { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; width: 100%; color: var(--pixel-muted); letter-spacing: 0.08em; background: rgb(17, 17, 17); justify-content: center; align-items: center; font-size: 12px; display: flex; }
